Container.Name: claude-in-container
Container.Overview:
Always-on Claude Code in tmux, reachable from phone or browser via Remote Control. Claude sees only the Data folder, which holds your projects and, in .home, its login, settings and runtime-installed tools.
Before installing: clone the repo and run CONTAINER_ENGINE="sudo docker" scripts/build.sh. The Data folder must be owned by the user in Extra Parameters (default --user 99:100), e.g. mkdir -p DIR && chown 99:100 DIR.
Tools with a version set below install into the Data folder on first start. Several containers can share one Data folder: give each its own name and set Continue to false on all but one.
First start: open the console (or: docker exec -it claude-in-container tmux new -A -s main) and log in with your Claude subscription.
Container.Requires: Image built locally with scripts/build.sh from the project repository.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The only host folder Claude sees: your projects, plus .home with login, settings and tools. Must be writable by the --user in Extra Parameters

Config.Name: Remote Control name
Config.Description: Session name shown in the Claude app; empty = container hostname

Config.Name: Continue
Config.Description: Resume the last conversation on start; false when another container shares this Data folder

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional; use instead of the subscription login. Disables Remote Control (subscription-only)

Config.Name: gh version
Config.Description: GitHub CLI version installed on start; empty = not installed

Config.Name: yq version
Config.Description: yq version installed on start; empty = not installed

Config.Name: jq version
Config.Description: jq version installed on start; empty = not installed

Config.Name: Terraform version
Config.Description: Terraform version installed on start; empty = not installed

Config.Name: AWS CLI version
Config.Description: AWS CLI v2 version installed on start; empty = not installed

Config.Name: npm tools
Config.Description: Space-separated name@version list installed on start

Config.Name: uv tools
Config.Description: Space-separated name==version list of Python CLIs installed on start
